Cloud Tokens business model is to take members invested money and use it to trade on different crypto exchanges by utilizing artificial intelligent robots. These robots are supposed to take advantage of price differences between different exchanges around the world and making a profit on the arbitrage. There is no proof whatsoever though, that Cloud is actually doing any type of trading or making any money. _x000D_
The company started in May 2019 and withdrawals of invested funds were possible until the end of September. However, since the end of September, it is impossible to get your money out of the system/app and the company issues excuse after excuse as to why withdrawals cannot be done. _x000D_
Cloud wallet can be downloaded on Googles Play Store and Apples play store here: _x000D_
